original: asyārthaḥ | prathamaṃ kalaśābhiṣeka iti | udakamukuṭavajraghaṇṭānām ācāryalakṣaṇāḥ ṣaṭ kalaśābhiṣekāḥ | bāhyavariṇeva bāhyamalasyāvidyāmalakṣālanāya sicyate 'neneti sekaḥ | eṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ kalaśavyāpārāt kalaśābhiṣekasaṃjñā | avaivartikābhiṣekāś caite ṣaṭ tathāgatasvabhāvāt | tathā hi udakābhiṣeka ādarśajñānātmako
analyzed: asya arthaḥ prathamam kalaśa abhiṣekaḥ iti udaka mukuṭa vajra ghaṇṭānām ācārya lakṣaṇāḥ ṣaṭ kalaśa abhiṣekāḥ bāhya variṇā iva bāhya malasya avidyā mala kṣālanāya sicyate nena iti sekaḥ eṣām sarveṣām kalaśa vyāpārāt kalaśa abhiṣeka saṃjñā avaivartika abhiṣekāḥ ca ete ṣaṭ tathāgata svabhāvāt tathā hi udaka abhiṣekaḥ ādarśa jñāna ātmakaḥ

original: 'kṣobhyasvabhāvaḥ | mukuṭābhiṣekaḥ samatājñānātmako ratnasaṃbhavasvabhāvaḥ | vajrābhiṣekaḥ pratyavekṣaṇājñānātmako 'mitābhasvabhāvaḥ | adhipatyabhiṣekaḥ kṛtyānuṣṭhānarūpo 'moghasiddhisvabhāvaḥ | nāmābhiṣeko 'vidyānirodhād vidyānugatasuviśuddhadharmadhātujñānātmako vairocanasvarūpaḥ | ācāryābhiṣekas tu vajrasattvasvabhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: kṣobhya svabhāvaḥ mukuṭa abhiṣekaḥ samatā jñāna ātmakaḥ ratna saṃbhava svabhāvaḥ vajra abhiṣekaḥ pratyavekṣaṇa ajñāna ātmakaḥ mita ābha svabhāvaḥ adhipati abhiṣekaḥ kṛtyā anuṣṭhāna rūpaḥ mogha siddhi svabhāvaḥ nāma abhiṣekaḥ vidyā nirodhāt vidyā anugata su viśuddha dharmadhātu jñāna ātmakaḥ vairocana svarūpaḥ ācārya abhiṣekaḥ tu vajra sattva svabhāvaḥ

original: atra ca pañcābhiṣeko vidyābhiṣekaḥ pañcasu locanādividyāyā vyāpārāt |
analyzed: atra ca pañca abhiṣekaḥ vidyā abhiṣekaḥ pañcasu locana ādi vidyāyāḥ vyāpārāt

original: atra cāvidyāmalakṣālanāyākṣobhyarūpeṇa vajrācāryeṇa vairocanarūpālambini śiṣye salilābhiṣeko deyaḥ | evaṃ sarvatrāhaṃkāraḥ ||
analyzed: atra ca avidyā mala kṣālanāya akṣobhya rūpeṇa vajra ācāryeṇa vairocana rūpa ālambini śiṣye salila abhiṣekaḥ deyaḥ evam sarvatra ahaṃkāraḥ

original: dvādaśāṅguliparimāṇena dvādaśāṅgapratītyasamutpādaviśuddhyā vajram | yatra madhyavṛtte niruttaradharmatāsūcako hūṃkāraḥ | tasyārthaḥ | ha iti hetuviyuktaḥ | ū ity ūhāpagataḥ | aṃ ity apratiṣṭhitaḥ sarvadharma iti | yatra bhavasarojamukhāt sphuranti pañcārarūpiṇo munayaḥ pañcaskandhaviśuddhyā niṣkrāntā bhavaśarīreṇa |
analyzed: dvādaśa aṅguli parimāṇena dvādaśa aṅga pratītyasamutpāda viśuddhyā vajram yatra madhya vṛtte niruttara dharmatā sūcakaḥ hūṃkāraḥ tasya arthaḥ ha iti hetu viyuktaḥ ū iti ūha apagataḥ aṃ iti apratiṣṭhitaḥ sarva dharmaḥ iti yatra bhava saroja mukhāt sphuranti pañca āra rūpiṇaḥ munayaḥ pañca skandha viśuddhyā niṣkrāntāḥ bhava śarīreṇa

original: iha ca madhyārābhimukhatayā paryantārāṇāṃ sarvarūpādayo vijñānātmakā iti sūcyante | ete ca sarve sarvātmakā iti nivedayituṃ sarvatraiva caturaśrī ||
analyzed: iha ca madhya ara abhimukha tayā paryanta arāṇām sarva rūpa ādayaḥ vijñāna ātmakāḥ iti sūcyante ete ca sarve sarva ātmakāḥ iti nivedayitum sarvatra eva caturaśrī

original: atha te dharmasya budhā hūṃnādaniveditātmarūpasya pañcāsivimuktakāyāḥ paryante cānyatra visphuritāḥ | śūnyatānimittāpraṇihitatāvabodhanārthaṃ sarvatra phullakātrayam | ete cādarśasamatāpratyavekṣaṇākṛtyānuṣṭhānasuviśuddhadharmadhātulakṣaṇapañcajñānātmakā gurūpadeśato jñeyāḥ ||
analyzed: atha te dharmasya budhāḥ hūṃnāda nivedita ātma rūpasya pañca asi vimukta kāyāḥ paryante ca anyatra visphuritāḥ śūnyatā nimitta apraṇihita tā avabodhana artham sarvatra phullakā trayam ete ca ādarśa samatā pratyavekṣaṇa ākṛtyā anuṣṭhāna su viśuddha dharmadhātu lakṣaṇa pañca jñāna ātmakāḥ guru upadeśataḥ jñeyāḥ

original: evaṃ vajraghaṇṭāpi pūrvābhisaṃdhānena dvādaśāṅguliparimāṇādhomukhāmbhojavajrasamāpattir niḥsvabhāvena sarvadharmasvabhāvaṃ pratipādayitum | abhedyajñānanidānatāṃ dharmodayasya bodhayitum ūrdhvādhobhāge ca vajrāvalī yugalamālinī | tridhātukasvabhāvakūṭāgāratām asya khyāpayituṃ hārārdhahāraprakārāḥ | ata eva pañcatathāgatāṅkitaḥ |
analyzed: evam vajraghaṇṭā api pūrva abhisaṃdhānena dvādaśa aṅguli parimāṇa adhomukha ambhoja vajra samāpattiḥ niḥsvabhāvena sarva dharma svabhāvam pratipādayitum abhedya jñāna nidāna tām dharma udayasya bodhayitum ūrdhva adhobhāge ca vajra āvalī yugala mālinī tri dhātuka svabhāva kūṭāgāra tām asya khyāpayitum hāra ardhahāra prakārāḥ atas eva pañca tathāgata aṅkitaḥ

original: śūnyatākaruṇābhinnajñānakāraṇatām āvedayitum upari prajñāmukhākhyānam | asya ca dharmadhātusvarūpasya jñānasya vairocanādipañcatathāgatātmakatāṃ ca
analyzed: śūnyatā karuṇā bhinna jñāna kāraṇatām āvedayitum upari prajñā mukha ākhyānam asya ca dharmadhātu svarūpasya jñānasya vairocana ādi pañca tathāgata ātmaka tām ca

original: rūpādipañcaskandhasvabhāvatāṃ ca pṛthivyādipañcadhāturūpatāṃ ca kathayitum ūrdhvaṃ pañcāraviracanā | atrāpi madhyasthitārābhimukhādyabhisaṃdhānaṃ pūrvavat | athābhiṣekam anayā svanantyā vajraghaṇṭayā kurvītānuttarāśeṣadharmabodhyadhikārakam |
analyzed: rūpa ādi pañca skandha svabhāva tām ca pṛthivī ādi pañca dhātu rūpatām ca kathayitum ūrdhvam pañca āra viracanā atra api madhya sthi tārā abhimukha ādi abhisaṃdhānam pūrvavat atha abhiṣekam anayā svanantyā vajraghaṇṭayā kurvīta anuttara aśeṣa dharma bodhi adhikārakam

original: iha prādhānyakhyāpanāya hetukatāpratipādanāya ca kāraṇabhūtam api vajraghaṇṭābhiṣekam ullaṅghya prathamaṃ vajrābhiṣekadānam |
analyzed: iha prādhānya khyāpanāya hetuka tā pratipādanāya ca kāraṇa bhūtam api vajraghaṇṭā abhiṣekam ullaṅghya prathamam vajra abhiṣeka dānam

original: ^ (116/229)prādhā•nyakhyāpanāya
analyzed: prādhānya khyāpanāya

original: sarvadharmā nāmata iti pratipādanārthaṃ bhaviṣyanmunīndrapadocitanāmanidānāvadānārthaṃ ca pūrvanāmavyapanayena svadevatākulagotrānusāreṇa nāmābhiṣekaḥ |
analyzed: sarva dharmāḥ nāmataḥ iti pratipādana artham bhaviṣyat muni indra pada ucita nāma nidāna avadāna artham ca pūrva nāma vyapanayena sva devatā kula gotra anusāreṇa nāma abhiṣekaḥ

original: ācāryābhiṣekaś ca vajrasamayaghaṇṭāsamayamudrāsamayabhavyatānujñāvratavyākaraṇāśvāsalakṣaṇaḥ | itaḥ prabhṛty asaṃskṛtābhedayuganaddhavāhibodhasamayas tvam iti bodhayituṃ vajrasamayaḥ | caturaśītidharmaskandhasahasraparas tvam iti pratipādanāya ghaṇṭāsamayaḥ | sveṣṭadevatāsvabhāvas tvam iti khyāpayituṃ mudrāsamayaḥ |
analyzed: ācārya abhiṣekaḥ ca vajra samaya ghaṇṭā samaya mudrā samaya bhavyatā anujñā vrata vyākaraṇa āśvāsa lakṣaṇaḥ itas prabhṛti a saṃskṛta a bheda yuga naddha vāhi bodha samayaḥ tvam iti bodhayitum vajra samayaḥ caturaśīti dharma skandha sahasra paraḥ tvam iti pratipādanāya ghaṇṭā samayaḥ sva iṣṭadevatā svabhāvaḥ tvam iti khyāpayitum mudrā samayaḥ

original: maṇḍalatattvaṃ maṇḍalaviśuddhilakṣaṇaṃ devatātattvaṃ devatāviśuddhilakṣaṇam ācāryaparikarma ca maṇḍalasādhanajñānaṃ pañcapradīpapañcāmṛtabhakṣaṇaṃ ca bhavyatā | tattvaṃ ca naiḥsvabhāvyam eṣām utpannakramapakṣataḥ | dharmacakrapravartanārtham anujñā |
analyzed: maṇḍala tattvam maṇḍala viśuddhi lakṣaṇam devatā tattvam devatā viśuddhi lakṣaṇam ācārya parikarma ca maṇḍala sādhana jñānam pañca pradīpa pañca amṛta bhakṣaṇam ca bhavya tā tattvam ca naiḥsvabhāvyam eṣām utpanna krama pakṣataḥ dharmacakra pravartana artham anujñā

original: bāhyavratanirākaraṇārthaṃ vajravratadānam | pṛthivyādisvabhāvatāsūcanāya vyākaraṇam | tathā hi bhuvo dharādeḥ svaḥ svarūpaṃ bhūr bhūyā iti bhūr bhuvaḥ svar ity asyārthaḥ | sarvāvaraṇavinirmuktaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvasamas tvam itaḥ prabhṛti bodhanārtham āśvāsaḥ |
analyzed: bāhya vrata nirākaraṇa artham vajra vrata dānam pṛthivī ādi svabhāva tā sūcanāya vyākaraṇam tathā hi bhuvaḥ dharā ādeḥ svar svarūpam bhūḥ bhūyāḥ iti bhūḥ bhuvaḥ svar iti asya arthaḥ sarva āvaraṇa vinirmuktaḥ sarva buddha bodhisattva samaḥ tvam itas prabhṛti bodhana artham āśvāsaḥ

original: prajñāśraddhākṣetrīkaraṇārthaṃ samayarakṣaṇārthaṃ ca samānakālobhayasaṃpāditabodhicittapradānaṃ guhyābhiṣekaḥ | prajñopāyaguhyābhyāṃ dāpayata iti vyutpattiḥ |
analyzed: prajñā śraddhā kṣetrīkaraṇa artham samaya rakṣaṇa artham ca samāna kāla ubhaya saṃpādita bodhi citta pradānam guhya abhiṣekaḥ prajñā upāya guhyābhyām dāpayate iti vyutpattiḥ

original: prajñājñānam ity atra
analyzed: prajñā jñānam iti atra

original: vyutpattidvayam | prajñāyā jñānam, prajñaiva bāhyā jñānam | tatra grāhyagrāhakākāradhāraṇī buddhiś caturdhātupañcaskandharūpādiṣaḍviṣayātmikāṅganāsvabhāvā prajñā | tasyā nimittabhūtāyā bodhicittajñānam iti pūrvā vyutpattiḥ | ākāradvayaśūnyā saiva vijñānam ity aparā vyutpattiḥ |
analyzed: vyutpatti dvayam prajñāyāḥ jñānam prajñā eva bāhyā jñānam tatra grāhya grāhaka ākāra dhāraṇī buddhiḥ catur dhātu pañca skandha rūpa ādi ṣaṣ viṣaya ātmikā aṅganā svabhāvā prajñā tasyāḥ nimitta bhūtāyāḥ bodhi citta jñānam iti pūrvā vyutpattiḥ ākāra dvaya śūnyā sā eva vijñānam iti aparā vyutpattiḥ

original: prajñājñānalakṣitasaptāṅgayuktasādhyaṃ caturthārtham ity eke | prajñājñānam evābhyasyamānaśaradamalagaganasaṃkāśaṃ caturthārtham ity apare | prajñājñānam eva prakṛtirūpaṃ vikārarūpaṃ prakṛtisamutpādātmakaṃ yuganaddhādvayavāhisuviśuddhasvabhāvaṃ caturthārtham ity apare | pakṣāntarāṇi ca vistarabhayād nocyante ||
analyzed: prajñā jñāna lakṣita sapta aṅga yukta sādhyam caturtha artham iti eke prajñā jñānam eva abhyasyamāna śarad amala gagana saṃkāśam caturtha artham iti apare prajñā jñānam eva prakṛti rūpam vikāra rūpam prakṛti samutpāda ātmakam yuga naddha advaya vāhi su viśuddha svabhāvam caturtha artham iti apare pakṣa antarāṇi ca vistara bhayāt na ucyante

analyzed: ati guhya seka saṃgraha vidhāna militena puṇya yuta ślokena

analyzed: nikhila jagataḥ stu vimala sphuṭa sugata subhāṣite kṣāntiḥ
